headline: Dallas Fed's Logan Sees At Least 50 Basis Points in Additional Rate Hikes
summary: While the Federal Reserve held interest rates steady, Dallas Fed official Lorie Logan indicated expectations for at least 50 basis points in additional rate hikes.
why: Federal Reserve official commentary shapes market expectations regarding the future path of benchmark interest rates and borrowing costs.

impacts.name: US Federal Funds Rate
impacts.why: Expectations of further hikes point toward a higher terminal federal funds rate path.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Comments from central bank officials signaling a hawkish monetary policy stance and potential further rate increases drive adjustments in yield expectations.
